title: MaleTheme Solo #019 · 남 머슬 모델·블루 라인·천사 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a snow-covered stone plaza in soft daylight with light snow lying only on the ground, a fountain edge under snow, standard lamp posts and a waist-high railing, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Hawaiian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, smooth warm bronze skin, a shy sweet smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a silver miniature anvil, a gold cube-shaped block, a copper barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop with a heavy rough silver a ship's anchor hanging at its end, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver rings. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above his head, a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at his back, and a minimal white satin with gold trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme red platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
